comparison.objective: Pump a chamber to 60 kPa and return the released pump.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterhold a free barrel while reciprocating a hand pump and reading a gauge.
comparison.success_condition: Pressure stays within 54–66 kPa and below 80 kPa, with correct final placement and two-second release.
comparison.reason: Bimanual counterholding is shared only generically; pressure generation and gauge stopping are different abilities.
